body.description: A mobile body with hands, able to carry up to one inventory unit.

room.name: Small room
room.description: A small stone room with a locked wooden door, a small open window high in the wall and a narrow flooded drain at floor level. The window and drain both lead outdoors, but neither can fit a medium or large body.

outside.name: Outside
outside.description: Fresh air. You have left the room.

window.name: Small high window
window.description: An open, unbarred window high in the stone wall leads outside. Only a small flying body can reach and pass through it; strength or flight alone cannot make a larger body fit.

drain.name: Small flooded drain
drain.description: A narrow drain at floor level leads outside through a flooded passage. Only a small swimming body can fit and traverse it. It is not a dry crawling route.

lock.name: Door lock
lock.description: A metal lock fitted to the door.

splinters.name: Wooden splinters
splinters.description: Fragments of a broken wooden box.

rock.name: Rock
rock.description: A heavy, rough-edged rock on the floor.

sleep.description: Rest where you are to recover from tiredness.
